visualCharacteristics.purpose: cover tier cards with a coloured header bar

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: header cell (optional icon, title, badge) | body cell (text, lists, horizontal rules, links). With one cell, content up to and including the first heading (plus a short badge paragraph) becomes the header

usage.when: comparing cover tiers / plan levels side by side

reuseGuidance: image for tall centred header bars, image-light for title + badge headers with feature lists, light for centred compact tiers.
